records.name: rocksdb::crc32c::ExtendImpl<Slow_CRC32>
records.reached_via: BSS function pointer at 0x6508908, written by init function 0x61c26d0
records.semantics: CRC-32C (Castagnoli, reflected polynomial 0x82f63b78) extend with pre/post inversion: result = ~raw(~crc, data). Byte-at-a-time prologue to the next 16-byte boundary using T0; slicing-by-4 main loop (16 bytes, then 8 bytes per round) with tables T3/T2/T1/T0 over the four bytes of each word; byte-at-a-time tail using T0. Returns crc unchanged for len 0.
records.signature: uint32_t (uint32_t crc, const uint8_t *data, size_t len)
records.table_relation: T0 is the standard CRC-32C base table generated from the polynomial; T1/T2/T3 equal T0 advanced by 1/2/3 zero bytes respectively, verified for all 256 entries.

records.caller_pattern: All three observed call sites pass crc2 = Extend(0, buf, len2), which is 0 when len2 == 0, so the degenerate case returns the correct value there. The site at 0x6054a79 is reachable with len2 == 0 (fall-through when rbp == 0); the crc2 value on that path is not established from the excerpt.
records.degenerate_case: No len2==0 early return: combine(crc1, crc2, 0) returns crc1 ^ crc2. The concatenation identity combine(Extend(0,A), Extend(0,B), |B|) = Extend(0, A||B) holds for |B| > 0 and was checked on 200 random pairs; it does not hold at len2 == 0 unless crc2 == 0.
records.name: rocksdb::crc32c::Crc32cCombine
records.semantics: combine(crc1, crc2, len2) = crc2 ^ advance_raw(crc1, 8*len2), where advance_raw is the reflected one-bit CRC step applied 8*len2 times. For each set bit p of len2>>2 the 32-entry table at 0x97cde0 supplies the polynomial for x^(32*2^p) and the inner loop multiplies the state by it; for len2 % 4 != 0 the remainder is advanced first through the public Extend entry over zero bytes (~Extend(~crc1, zeros, len2&3)). Stack canary present; __stack_chk_fail on mismatch.
records.signature: uint32_t (uint32_t crc1, uint32_t crc2, size_t len2)
